text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She has finished her debut race, but 
graded stakes will draw even bigger 
crowds. Something must be done about this 
extreme "timidness."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Timidness is a sign of anxiety. If she 
interacts with Daitaku Helios and Mejiro 
Palmer, the fun they share should make 
that anxiety vanish.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
From now on, she will be running in plenty 
of races. Time to get used to various 
kinds of races and Umamusume.
